effect_description_eng: [Hand] [Main] If you have a [Ruli Tsukiyono] in play, by placing 1 [SymbareAngoramon] from your hand under 1 of your [Angoramon] as its bottom digivolution card, digivolve that Digimon into this card for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
